data.desc: Onconetix (Nasdaq: ONCO) is a commercial stage biotechnology company focused on the research, development and commercialization of innovative solutions for men's health and oncology. Onconetix owns Proclarix®, an in vitro diagnostic test for prostate cancer originally developed by Proteomedix and approved for sale in the European Union ('EU') under the IVDR, which it anticipates will be marketed in the U.S. as a lab developed test ('LDT') through its license agreement with Labcorp.
